meta.title: GAL Stejarul Dacilor — Local Action Group in the Republic of Moldova
meta.description: The Local Action Group Stejarul Dacilor actively contributes to the development of rural communities in the Cimișlia–Căușeni districts, supporting local initiatives. Through the projects we support, we contribute to the economic, social, and cultural development of villages, the valorization of resources, and cooperation between communities. We aim for more prosperous villages, well connected and future-oriented — through active involvement, innovative ideas, and the efficient use of resources for the benefit of the people.

aboutUs.title: About Us — Local Action Group Stejarul Dacilor
aboutUs.description: The Local Action Group Stejarul Dacilor is a local association registered on November 23, 2023, bringing together actors from the public, civic, and entrepreneurial sectors. The LAG promotes sustainable rural development in its coverage area, based on its own Local Development Strategy, elaborated in a participatory manner and adapted to the needs of member communities.

administration.title: Leadership of the LAG — Local Action Group Stejarul Dacilor
administration.description: Discover the people who guide the activity of the LAG Stejarul Dacilor — from the General Assembly to the executive committees. Get to know the internal structure, the roles, and the way we make decisions for the community.

documents.title: Official Documents — Local Action Group Stejarul Dacilor
documents.description: Transparency is essential. Access the statute, strategies, annual reports, and other key documents that define our direction and commitments to the localities in the region.

news.title: Stay informed and follow our activity in the region and beyond.
news.description: Here we publish the most important news and updates from the activity of LAG 'Stejarul Dacilor': open calls, local events, trainings, collaborations, civic initiatives, and the promotion of successes in the region. Stay informed and engaged in everything relevant happening in our area!

authenticLocal.title: Discover the authenticity of the region through local products, attractions, people, and community services.
authenticLocal.description: Behind every town and village in our region lie stories, people, traditions, and initiatives that bring meaning and value to everyday life. This section is dedicated to promoting authentic local resources – from carefully crafted household products, to services offered by small entrepreneurs, places worth visiting, and people who keep the spirit of the community alive.

projects.title: Projects that turn ideas into reality and inspire an entire community.
projects.description: Each project contributes to a more sustainable, fair, and active rural environment. The projects supported by LAG directly address local needs: modernization of public institutions, support for entrepreneurs, environmental protection, cultural activities, and youth engagement.

localProducts.title: Discover local products with history, taste, and soul from our region.
localProducts.description: Here you will find products crafted with care, passion, and skill by artisans, producers, and entrepreneurs from the member villages of LAG 'Stejarul Dacilor'. Whether we speak of handmade objects, traditional preserves, artisanal goods, or folk art items, each product tells a local story, carries an identity, and supports a vibrant and sustainable rural economy. We promote what is authentic, high-quality, and born from local tradition and innovation.

peopleAndValues.title: People who inspire through actions, values, and local involvement.
peopleAndValues.description: Here we present people who inspire by their own example. Each of them contributes, through their work and vocation, to the development of a vibrant, dignified community connected to the values that unite us: solidarity, respect for tradition, and the courage to bring positive change.

services.title: Local resources and services that support the region’s development.
services.description: Beyond the picturesque landscapes and authentic hospitality, the LAG localities hide a diverse network of services and activities that contribute to quality of life and sustainable development. We invite you to discover concrete examples of local services – from craft workshops and educational centers, to agritourism guesthouses, tourism activities, social initiatives, or small-scale artisanal production.

touristAttractions.title: Discover the emblematic places of the region – tradition, nature, and heritage.
touristAttractions.description: This section showcases the places and experiences that define the identity of the region, from natural attractions and heritage monuments to festivals, local gastronomy, and family-based tourism initiatives. Rural tourism comes alive through the people and places that keep the authentic village spirit alive.

termsAndConditions.title: Terms and Conditions of Use
termsAndConditions.description: Learn about the platform's purpose, collected data, personal information protection, user responsibilities, and the applicable legislation in the Republic of Moldova.

termsAndConditions.general_info_text1: The website galstejaruldacilor.md is managed by GAL 'Stejarul Dacilor', a Public Association, with fiscal code (IDNO) 1023620009335, headquartered in Selemet village, Cimișlia district, Republic of Moldova.
termsAndConditions.general_info_text2:
For questions or additional information, you can contact us:

• E-mail: info@galstejaruldacilor.md
• Phone: +373 62 026 342

By accessing and using this website, you agree to comply with these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the website.
termsAndConditions.website_reason_text: The website galstejaruldacilor.md aims to inform and promote the activity of GAL 'Stejarul Dacilor' by transparently presenting implemented projects, local products and producers, crafts, services, and community initiatives. The platform supports the visibility of the GAL territory and facilitates communication with members, partners, and interested citizens, having an exclusively informative character, without commercial purpose or online transactions.
termsAndConditions.what_we_colect_text:
Through the contact form, we may collect the following personal data:

• Name and surname
• E-mail address
• Phone number (optional)
• Message content
termsAndConditions.reason_to_collect_text:
The personal data collected are used exclusively for:

• communication with users,
• responding to requests, complaints, or questions sent via the contact form.
termsAndConditions.data_protection_text1: GAL 'Stejarul Daciilor' complies with national legislation on personal data protection, including Law no. 133/2011. The collected data will not be disclosed to third parties without the user's express consent, except as provided by law.
termsAndConditions.data_protection_text2: Users have the right to request access to their data, rectification, deletion, or restriction of processing, in accordance with current legislation, by written request to: info@galstejaruldacilor.md.
termsAndConditions.user_responsability_text:
Website users undertake:

• to provide real and correct data in the contact form,
• not to transmit illegal, abusive content or content that infringes the rights of others.
termsAndConditions.responsability_limit_text: GAL 'Stejarul Dacilor' makes every effort to ensure the accuracy and timeliness of the information published on galstejaruldacilor.md, but does not guarantee that it is complete, error-free, or permanently updated. The content is strictly informative and does not constitute official recommendations or firm commitments.
termsAndConditions.responsability_limit_text_2:
GAL 'Stejarul Dacilor' is not responsible for:

• possible errors, omissions in the published information;
• use or interpretation of the website information by third parties;
• temporary interruptions of website operation;
• content of other websites to which there may be external links.
Users access and use the website at their own risk.
termsAndConditions.modify_text: We reserve the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time, without prior notice. The updated version will always be available on this page.
termsAndConditions.legislation_text: This document is governed by the legislation of the Republic of Moldova. Any dispute will be settled by the competent courts of the Republic of Moldova.
